title: Finite coefficient filtration preserves constructibility and the cohomological interval
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme with small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], let $B$ be a finite commutative ring, and let $B_Y$ be its constant sheaf of rings [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Let $\mathcal R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on this site and $\rho:\mathcal R\to B_Y$ a unital morphism. Let $P$ be an integer-indexed cochain complex of $\mathcal R$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] whose terms are flat: tensoring sheaves of $\mathcal R$-modules with $P^q$ is exact for every $q$ [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Let $V$ be a finite $B$-module equipped with a finite decreasing filtration by $B$-submodules $V=V_0\supseteq V_1\supseteq\cdots\supseteq V_t=0$, where $t\ge0$, and write $W_j=V_j/V_{j+1}$ for $0\le j<t$. For any such module $U$, write $U_Y$ for its constant module sheaf, regarded as an $\mathcal R$-module through $\rho$, and put $C_U=P\otimes_{\mathcal R}U_Y$, a complex of $B_Y$-modules, using termwise sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Fix integers $r\le s$ and assume that for every $0\le j<t$ all cohomology sheaves of $C_{W_j}$ are constructible $B_Y$-modules [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf] and vanish outside $[r,s]$. Then, for every $0\le j\le t$, all cohomology sheaves of $C_{V_j}$ are constructible $B_Y$-modules and vanish outside the same interval $[r,s]$. In particular this holds for $P\otimes_{\mathcal R}V_Y$, independently of the length $t$ of the filtration.
